tracks.attribution: "Kyrie eleison", Schola Gregoriana (Oltarzew), conducted by Fr. Dariusz Smolarek SAC, 2007; Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
tracks.note: Commons page: recorded by Schola Gregoriana of the Pallottine Seminary in Oltarzew (male voices); copyright holder gave written permission for CC/GFDL (OTRS ticket 2008031210015414); license cc-by-sa-3.0. Genuine sung human chant, no AI. Only 42 s long (shorter than the requested 2 min); 2 s fade in, 3 s fade out. Derivatives must be shared alike.
